summary: Published vendor-risk-review runx skill evaluates vendor contract text against a supplied trust policy, writes durable source-grounded vendor risk records through data-store when safe, stops before write on missing or ambiguous policy context, and proves the canonical sha-f73efbe9b874 package with hosted harness and Linux dogfood verification.
publish_method: Authenticated hosted publish through the runx public API using the GitHub-linked publish token; hosted registry reran the inline package harness and recorded status passed.

review_gate_summary.x_yaml_raw_url_commit_pinned: Frantic redelivery supplies x_yaml as a raw.githubusercontent.com URL pinned to the PR head commit; the inline harness cases below are copied from skills/vendor-risk-review/X.yaml for reviewer visibility.

x_yaml_harness_cases.name: approve-with-conditions-sla-gap
x_yaml_harness_cases.write_shape: append_event under aggregate_id vendor:acme-analytics with expected_version from read_projection

x_yaml_harness_cases.name: sealed-rejection-unbounded-liability
x_yaml_harness_cases.write_shape: durable rejected vendor risk record, not a notification or authority grant

x_yaml_harness_cases.name: stop-missing-policy-no-write
x_yaml_harness_cases.stop_reason: missing policy fields or ambiguous vendor identity

decision.reason: Approved with conditions under vrp-2026-06: recoverable gaps must be remediated before procurement completion.
conditions: Add SLA term required by vrp-2026-06: incident response within 24 hours.

receipt_verify_json.source: Linux GitHub Actions dogfood verification recorded in skills/vendor-risk-review/verification.json and action evidence.

input.contract_text: Acme Analytics will process only pseudonymized customer data under SOC2 controls. Liability is capped at USD 50000. Termination for convenience is available on 30 days notice. Support includes business-hours response but does not include the requested uptime credit language.

observations.name: x_yaml_raw_artifact
observations.detail: The X.yaml artifact is a directly fetchable raw.githubusercontent.com URL for skills/vendor-risk-review/X.yaml; the Frantic redelivery also supplies a commit-pinned x_yaml artifact URL.

observations.name: canonical_version_consistency
observations.detail: All submitted delivery artifacts use the canonical published ref iwannabefree00/vendor-risk-review@sha-f73efbe9b874, including public_url, evidence_json, report, action-verification.json, hosted harness, and dogfood receipt.

observations.name: structured_dogfood
observations.detail: The evidence_json.dogfood object names package, input, command, receipt_ref, verify_verdict, and all three harness_cases with per-case status objects; receipt_ref is runx:receipt:sha256:39ac11170b0aa565bb96ba58d1e6115c149ce068906478dd5fb930d36442d5f9 from the Linux GitHub Actions dogfood run.

observations.name: registry_publication
observations.detail: Published registry ref iwannabefree00/vendor-risk-review@sha-f73efbe9b874 is live at the submitted runx.ai public URL and installable through runx add.

observations.name: hosted_harness
observations.detail: The hosted registry harness endpoint for iwannabefree00/vendor-risk-review@sha-f73efbe9b874 returned status passed with three declared cases and three hosted receipt ids.

observations.name: approval_condition_grounding
observations.detail: The approve-with-conditions dogfood output grounds its condition in policy.required_sla_terms: the contract lacks incident response within 24 hours while meeting SOC2, max liability, and termination requirements.

observations.name: rejection_grounding
observations.detail: The rejection case refuses approval when supplied contract terms breach policy.max_liability or data_handling_floor, and records a durable rejection event rather than inventing an ungrounded red flag.

observations.name: stop_path
observations.detail: The missing-policy / ambiguous-vendor path exits with failure and no data-store append_event, preserving the human escalation lane before any durable write.

observations.name: data_store_append
observations.detail: Dogfood append_event evidence: aggregate_id vendor:acme-analytics, expected_version/before_version 2, after_version 3, idempotency_key vendor:acme-analytics:vrp-2026-06:approved:3d5ea4cbef355c97, policy_id vrp-2026-06, created_at 2026-06-29T05:00:00Z.

observations.name: dogfood_receipt
observations.detail: GitHub Actions dogfooded the published registry ref and recorded runx:receipt:sha256:39ac11170b0aa565bb96ba58d1e6115c149ce068906478dd5fb930d36442d5f9 in action-verification.json.

observations.name: frantic_machine_check
observations.detail: Frantic delivery c7d9683f-e4dc-482e-a214-699317218c4b passed machine verification 20/20; the later auto-review fallback reported an advisory infrastructure failure before judging the delivery.

observations.name: windows_note
observations.detail: The local Windows host can publish and install, but direct local runx skill execution can hit a runx receipt-store os error 87 before case execution; hosted registry harness and Linux GitHub Actions are the authoritative executed proof paths.
